behavioral.label: Telemetry — Off/Local/Cloud selector buttons

behavioral.label: Theme — Arcane/Void/Glacier selector
behavioral.evidence: onClick calls update({theme:t.id}); triggers applyTheme() immediately, then persists via setGuiPreference; theme is in GUI_PREF_KEYS

behavioral.label: Gamification — Mode select (Balanced/Serious/Learning)
behavioral.evidence: onChange calls updateGamify({mode}); persisted via invoke('set_gamify_settings')

behavioral.label: Keybinds section — all entries
behavioral.evidence: Keybinds section is a static read-only display list (div/kbd elements, no interactive handlers). No onClick, no onChange, no way to edit or rebind shortcuts from this surface. The KEYBINDS array is a hardcoded constant.

behavioral.label: Mesh — trust/untrust button per peer
behavioral.evidence: onClick calls toggleTrust(p); invokes invoke('trust_mesh_node',...) or invoke('untrust_mesh_node',{nodeId}) then reloads

behavioral.label: Keys & Secrets — remove button (per secret)

behavioral.evidence: onClick calls move(index, index-1/+1) -> onChange(reorderHudTile(...)); propagated to parent

behavioral.label: HudTiles section
behavioral.evidence: Both hudTilesConfig and onHudTilesChange are threaded from App.tsx surfaceProps (lines 1084-1085); the conditional guard renders the HudTilesEditor correctly.

behavioral.label: Signing key rotation — uses window.prompt for password input
behavioral.evidence: Functionally works but uses native window.prompt() for password — a UX regression: no styled input, no accessible label, no cancel state feedback, and breaks in Tauri webview environments that restrict dialogs

visual.issue: Toggle thumb uses hardcoded `bg-[#fafafa]` instead of a Limes design token (e.g. `bg-text-primary` or a surface token)
RangeInline uses `rgb(var(--brass))` inline style via JS template literal — not a Tailwind token class; this pattern bypasses Tailwind purge and is inconsistent with the rest of the token usage
Mesh peer online indicator uses `bg-emerald-400` (raw Tailwind color) instead of a Limes semantic token (e.g. `bg-status-ok` or equivalent)
Trusted peer badge uses `bg-emerald-400/15 text-emerald-300` raw color classes — repeated across Mesh, Signing, and Secrets sections (6+ occurrences). Should use a semantic token.
Signing key icon uses `text-amber-300` raw Tailwind color instead of a Limes token (e.g. `text-caution` or similar)
Secrets 'required' badge uses `bg-amber-400/15 text-amber-300`; 'set' badge uses `bg-emerald-400/15 text-emerald-300`; 'missing' uses `bg-bg-elevated/40` — inconsistent raw colors vs tokens
Keybinds section is purely display — no interactive elements, but there is no note, heading structure, or ARIA to indicate it is read-only. Users may expect to click/edit entries.
Signing key rotation uses window.prompt() for password entry — not accessible (no aria-*, no focus management, no screen-reader-friendly modal). Should be replaced with an in-surface form.
Taxonomy group collapse toggle button (Keys & Secrets) has no aria-expanded attribute — screen readers cannot tell whether the group is collapsed or expanded
Gamification section uses a plain `<label>/<input type=checkbox>` and `<select>` without the Row component used everywhere else, creating visual inconsistency (no border card, no hint text style)

RangeInline has a fixed `w-52` container. On narrow viewports (Settings nav in 3-col layout) combined values plus suffix may overflow or clip, especially in the Scaling section where suffixes are ' MiB' (4 chars) with a `w-14` readout.
Control-plane error banner uses `border-amber-400/20 bg-amber-400/5 text-amber-300` raw Tailwind colors — no Limes caution token applied
